title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior (Go & Type)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.


O seu papel como Software Engineering Backend:

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.

title: Independent M&A Partner
description:
Junte-se à Elite Global: Escale sua Prática de M&A no Coração Econômico da América Latina


Eleve sua assessoria ao aderir à rede de M&A internacional mais prestigiada do mundo.


O ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida Partners de M&A, MDs e boutiques financeiras baseadas em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e nos hubs do Agronegócio a integrarem nossa rede de alto desempenho. Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica de parceria para profissionais independentes que desejam alavancar uma marca global e uma infraestrutura de banco de investimento de classe mundial.


Por que os Partners no Brasil estão escolhendo a ONEtoONE em 2026


O mercado brasileiro em 2026 exige sofisticação. Com a consolidação de setores como Saúde, Logística e Clean Energy , as empresas de médio porte (Middle Market) brasileiras tornaram-se alvos primordiais para o capital estrangeiro.


  • Presença Global, Autoridade Local: Conecte-se a mais de 150 assessores em 80+ cidades. Mantenha sua independência enquanto utiliza uma marca que liga a Faria Lima e o Leblon aos centros financeiros de Nova York, Frankfurt e Xangai.
  • A Ponte do Agronegócio e Tech: O Brasil lidera em Agtech, Fintech e Transição Energética . Utilize nossa tecnologia de IA proprietária para conectar empresas brasileiras a compradores estratégicos globais com precisão absoluta.
  • Sem Barreiras Geográficas: Não acreditamos em exclusividade territorial engessada. Quer esteja liderando um exit de tecnologia em Florianópolis, uma consolidação industrial no interior de SP ou um projeto de infraestrutura no Nordeste, você tem total liberdade global.


Um Back-Office de Elite ao seu Dispor


O mercado de 2026 não aceita amadorismo. Nós cuidamos da complexidade técnica para que você foque no relacionamento e na originação:


  • Suporte na Execução: Equipe especializada de analistas para confecção de Teasers, Infomemos e modelos financeiros complexos (DCF, LBO) do pitch ao closing.
  • Dados Globais: Acesso premium a 450 milhões de perfis de empresas e inteligência transacional em tempo real para garantir que seus valuations sejam inquestionáveis internacionalmente.
  • CRM de M&A Avançado: Um ecossistema digital desenhado para o Mid-Market, garantindo eficiência e total sigilo em cada transação.


Perfil Ideal do Partner


Buscamos líderes da comunidade financeira brasileira que possuam:


  • 10+ Anos de Experiência: Trajetória comprovada em Investment Banking, Private Equity ou Corporate Finance.
  • Rede Estratégica: Relacionamento sólido com donos de empresas, grupos familiares ou fundos de PE/VC.
  • Mentalidade Empreendedora: Desejo de gerir sua própria operação com o suporte de uma plataforma global.
  • Especialização Setorial: Conhecimento profundo em áreas como Agronegócio, Tecnologia, Saúde, Logística ou Energia.


Vantagens da Parceria


Colaboração Global: Acesso direto a partners em 80+ cidades para encontrar o comprador estratégico que paga o maior prêmio.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.



Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: Analista de Crédito e Cobrança Pleno
description:
A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo ! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 149 lojas no país.


A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.

Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.


Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


Descrição Resumida:

Auxilia nas atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento, contas a receber e cobrança, atuando sob supervisão para garantir o processamento preciso e pontual das transações de crédito e contas a receber. Contribui para a eficiência e eficácia das operações do departamento.


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoio na análise de crédito: Responsável pela análise da capacidade de crédito dos clientes e na tomada de decisões com base nas políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos. Isso envolve a revisão de relatórios de crédito, demonstrações financeiras e históricos de pagamento para avaliar o risco de crédito, fazer liberação emergencial de limite de crédito, realizar validação e revisão cadastral dos clientes, realizar bloqueio e desbloqueio de cadastro conforme política interna.
  • Faturamento: Atuar no processo de faturamento, enviando faturas aos clientes de forma precisa e pontual. Isso inclui verificar as informações de cobrança, aplicar descontos ou ajustes apropriados e resolver divergências de faturamento.
  • Assistência na cobrança: Responsável nas atividades de cobrança, entrando em contato com clientes para acompanhar pagamentos em atraso e resolver pendências. Isso pode envolver o envio de lembretes, negociação de prazos e escalonamento de cobranças, quando necessário. Outras atividades de apoio à cobrança envolvem enviar relatórios de acompanhamento para as lojas e preparar envio de cartas de anuência.


Requisitos

  • Superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração ou experiência equivalentes;
  • Fortes habilidades de pesquisa e análise.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita e habilidades de negociação.
  • Excelentes habilidades interpessoais, com comprovada capacidade de resolução de disputas.
  • Conhecimento de atividades de crédito, cobrança e contas a receber.
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente é um diferencial


Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios: Assistência médica com participação, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio em academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e desconto de 20% em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

  • Habilidade analítica para detectar problemas e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Proatividade e boa comunicação para colaborar com diferentes equipes.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER

O QUE OFERECEMOS PRA VOCÊ

title: [Suporte] Analista de Suporte Técnico Pleno | Protheus
description:
Apoiar no suporte técnico do ERP Protheus em Regra de Negócio e Análises técnicas nos módulos Financeiro, Contabilidade Gerencial, Ativo Fixo e Planejamento e Controle Orçamentário.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar o atendimento aos clientes, por meio dos canais TOTVS, esclarecendo suas dúvidas sobre assuntos referentes ao sistema, registrando sugestões e incidentes;
  • Registrar, em sistema, a solicitação do cliente com todas as evidências (tickets abertos) de detalhamento necessárias para todos os impactados;
  • Triar os tickets abertos pelo cliente e reclassificá-los ou categorizá-los, quando necessário, pelo tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento;
  • Fornecer status das demandas em evolução, quando solicitado pelo cliente, por meio de canais de atendimento (telefônico, por e-mail, sistema);
  • Escalonar, para o próximo nível, as solicitações ou incidentes que não forem evoluídos, após o esgotamento das possibilidades de solução dentro do tempo estimado pela Coordenação da área;
  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/metas da área;
  • Alertar a coordenação e atuar em potenciais riscos ou crises em clientes;
  • Manter atualizados FAQs/banco de conhecimento com as soluções definidas e repassadas aos clientes;
  • Apoiar nos processos de melhorias, detectando novas soluções, identificando problemas e questões relevantes;
  • Realização de consultorias de suporte ou técnicas aos clientes
  • Prestar o atendimento, por meio de canais de abertura de tickets, de acordo com o processo definido e visando ao atendimento e às metas estabelecidas;


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Conhecimento técnico e de negócio nos módulos Financeiro, Contabilidade Gerencial, Ativo Fixo e Planejamento e Controle Orçamentário (PCO);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados;
  • Linguagem de programação ADVPL;
  • Análise e depuração de código fonte;
  • Conhecimento na arquitetura, instalação e configuração do Protheus;

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.



Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: Analista de Crédito e Cobrança Pleno
description:
A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo ! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 149 lojas no país.


A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.

Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.


Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


Descrição Resumida:

Auxilia nas atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento, contas a receber e cobrança, atuando sob supervisão para garantir o processamento preciso e pontual das transações de crédito e contas a receber. Contribui para a eficiência e eficácia das operações do departamento.


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoio na análise de crédito: Responsável pela análise da capacidade de crédito dos clientes e na tomada de decisões com base nas políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos. Isso envolve a revisão de relatórios de crédito, demonstrações financeiras e históricos de pagamento para avaliar o risco de crédito, fazer liberação emergencial de limite de crédito, realizar validação e revisão cadastral dos clientes, realizar bloqueio e desbloqueio de cadastro conforme política interna.
  • Faturamento: Atuar no processo de faturamento, enviando faturas aos clientes de forma precisa e pontual. Isso inclui verificar as informações de cobrança, aplicar descontos ou ajustes apropriados e resolver divergências de faturamento.
  • Assistência na cobrança: Responsável nas atividades de cobrança, entrando em contato com clientes para acompanhar pagamentos em atraso e resolver pendências. Isso pode envolver o envio de lembretes, negociação de prazos e escalonamento de cobranças, quando necessário. Outras atividades de apoio à cobrança envolvem enviar relatórios de acompanhamento para as lojas e preparar envio de cartas de anuência.


Requisitos

  • Superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração ou experiência equivalentes;
  • Fortes habilidades de pesquisa e análise.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita e habilidades de negociação.
  • Excelentes habilidades interpessoais, com comprovada capacidade de resolução de disputas.
  • Conhecimento de atividades de crédito, cobrança e contas a receber.
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente é um diferencial


Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios: Assistência médica com participação, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio em academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e desconto de 20% em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

title: [Suporte] Analista de Suporte Técnico Pleno | Protheus
description:
Apoiar no suporte técnico do ERP Protheus em Regra de Negócio e Análises técnicas nos módulos Financeiro, Contabilidade Gerencial, Ativo Fixo e Planejamento e Controle Orçamentário.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar o atendimento aos clientes, por meio dos canais TOTVS, esclarecendo suas dúvidas sobre assuntos referentes ao sistema, registrando sugestões e incidentes;
  • Registrar, em sistema, a solicitação do cliente com todas as evidências (tickets abertos) de detalhamento necessárias para todos os impactados;

title: Analista de Crédito e Cobrança Pleno
description:
A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo ! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 149 lojas no país.


A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.

Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.


Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


Descrição Resumida:

Auxilia nas atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento, contas a receber e cobrança, atuando sob supervisão para garantir o processamento preciso e pontual das transações de crédito e contas a receber. Contribui para a eficiência e eficácia das operações do departamento.


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoio na análise de crédito: Responsável pela análise da capacidade de crédito dos clientes e na tomada de decisões com base nas políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos. Isso envolve a revisão de relatórios de crédito, demonstrações financeiras e históricos de pagamento para avaliar o risco de crédito, fazer liberação emergencial de limite de crédito, realizar validação e revisão cadastral dos clientes, realizar bloqueio e desbloqueio de cadastro conforme política interna.
  • Faturamento: Atuar no processo de faturamento, enviando faturas aos clientes de forma precisa e pontual. Isso inclui verificar as informações de cobrança, aplicar descontos ou ajustes apropriados e resolver divergências de faturamento.
  • Assistência na cobrança: Responsável nas atividades de cobrança, entrando em contato com clientes para acompanhar pagamentos em atraso e resolver pendências. Isso pode envolver o envio de lembretes, negociação de prazos e escalonamento de cobranças, quando necessário. Outras atividades de apoio à cobrança envolvem enviar relatórios de acompanhamento para as lojas e preparar envio de cartas de anuência.


Requisitos

  • Superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração ou experiência equivalentes;
  • Fortes habilidades de pesquisa e análise.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita e habilidades de negociação.
  • Excelentes habilidades interpessoais, com comprovada capacidade de resolução de disputas.
  • Conhecimento de atividades de crédito, cobrança e contas a receber.
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente é um diferencial


Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios: Assistência médica com participação, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio em academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e desconto de 20% em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.



Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: JR Partnership Programs Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Front-end Developer (React.js) - Project
description:
We are looking for a remote, skilled Senior Front-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React.js to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping ideas and user feedback into delightful experiences, developing and implementing user interface components into the latest React.js concepts and workflows, and leading the engineering efforts for user-facing features. You will work with our product and user experience teams to deliver end-to-end features that deliver business value that users love.


This project has a 6-month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform allows companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the User Experience and Product teams to create end-to-end designs for new features
  • Take ownership of product features from design, implementation, and delivery, to post-delivery feedback and follow-up work
  • Coordinate development efforts across team members and ensure successful delivery
  • Architect, develop, and implement highly-responsive user interface components using JavaScript and React.js
  • Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, and help find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience as a front-end engineer writing single-page applications that communicate with API back-ends, and knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A well-developed understanding of frontend concepts and various frameworks
  • A focus on delivering value to customers
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field
  • Node.js and Python experience
  • Additional Information
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays annually
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger


The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor sênior
description:
Vaga desenvolvedor Sênior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Sobre o cargo: Como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior, você vai atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas, APIs e serviços que compõem ao ecossistema de produtos da empresa.


Responsabilidades Principais:


  • Criar e manter APIs/Serviços, garantindo performance, segurança e escalabilidade.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, além de otimizar sistemas para melhorar a performance.
  • Trabalhar na integração de sistemas internos e de terceiros.
  • Participar de reuniões para entendimento de requisitos, refinamento de demandas e planejamento de sprints.
  • Escrever testes automatizados (unitários, integração e end-to-end) para garantir a estabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar sistemas/serviços em produção, analisando logs e métricas para garantir a estabilidade e desempenho dos serviços.
  • Implementar boas práticas de segurança no desenvolvimento, proteção de dados e autenticação de sistemas.
  • Em conjunto com a liderança técnica e arquitetura, avaliar e propor novas ferramentas, tecnologias e práticas para melhorar o ecossistema da empresa
  • Documentar processos e melhorias implementadas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Proficiência em Java e outras linguagens de programação. (experiência mínima de 4 anos )
  • Graduação concluída na área de TI;
  • Habilidade para identificar e solucionar desafios técnicos de forma eficiente.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código com Git;
  • Noções de banco de dados PostgreSQL e Mongo;
  • Experiência com Quarkus ou Spring Boot ;
  • Busca constante por melhorias nos sistemas e processos existentes.
  • Capacidade de documentar código e comunicar ideias técnicas de forma clara.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas: Busca contínua por aprendizado e soluções eficazes. Capacidade de colaborar em equipe, receber feedback construtivo e contribuir para o sucesso do projeto


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com sistemas legados desenvolvidos a partir do Java 8;
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação Node, Typescript, React e Angular;
  • Familiaridade e experiência com o uso de Docker para implantação e gestão de contêineres;
  • Experiência prévia com aplicativos de gerenciamento de caches e/ou sistemas de filas de eventos.



Por que #VemParaSyonet ? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente

title: Senior Software Developer (C# / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in C# and .NET to join our U.S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop, and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms, particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystems, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers, having led the market since 2014. With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using C# and .NET, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
  • Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
  • Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
  • Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, PostgreSQL, AWS, MongoDB,.NET, PHP, RoR, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionality

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience with expertise in C# and .NET
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications, and NetSuite
  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction
  • Strong proficiency in database design and management (Salesforce Objects and triggers, MongoDB, SQL), RESTful API development, and cloud services integration with experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in leading software product development projects
  • Hands-on experience leading technical teams both onshore, offshore & nearshore
  • Working under limited supervision and developing code for new business features based on functional and technical specs
  • Decomposes features for a sprint team into tasks that can be accomplished within a sprint; Provides work BPLOE for tasks
  • Understands and adheres to the area's software lifecycle process
  • Communicates across and outside of the team to answer questions, resolve issues, and assess impacts on other teams of changes being made in their sprint team
  • Learns and utilizes new technologies as required, serves as an expert technical resource, advisor, and mentor in one or more feature sets or technologies supported by the development team
  • Provides technical mentorship and work task direction to a team of developers; able to fill the Technical Owner role on an agile sprint team, holding people accountable for task delivery
  • Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Knowledge of authentication systems (OAuth/OICS, OWASP security best practices, including rate limiting and data encryption
  • Familiarity with AWS services, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices, with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement effective solutions
  • Experience with DMS and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Cox/VinSolutions, DealerSocket, DealerAccess), and VIN providers (e.g., DataOne, Polk, VinPower)
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager (GTM), or Tag Assistant (GTA)
  • Knowledge of SaaS environments and SDLC methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Roadmap Release)
  • Knowledge in Business Intelligence tools, ETL, or reporting

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Service Cloud Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58531



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar funcionalidades em Apex (triggers, services, batch/queueable/schedulable), garantindo bulkification, testes e respeito aos limites da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver Lightning Web Components (LWC) com arquitetura limpa, performance, consumo de dados via LDS/wire e chamadas @AuraEnabled.
  • Construir e manter integrações (REST/SOAP): callouts com Named Credentials, autenticação (OAuth/JWT), tratamento de erros e observabilidade (logs/monitoramento).
  • Atuar no ecossistema de Service Cloud & Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp, Bots), integrando fluxos de atendimento e automações.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado (debug logs, trace flags, Event Monitoring) e otimizações de performance/consultas.
  • Versionar e implantar com SFDX + Git (branching, code review, qualidade de código).
  • Garantir segurança e compliance (FLS/CRUD, compartilhamento, transações) e produzir documentação técnica de suporte às entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Forte experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce (Pleno/Sênior) com foco em Service Cloud.
  • Domínio de Apex, SOQL/SOSL, padrões assíncronos e testes unitários (qualidade e cobertura).
  • Experiência com LWC (JS moderno, componentização, comunicação com Apex).
  • Vivência com Digital Engagement (Chat/Messaging/WhatsApp), incluindo implementação técnica e integração com processos de atendimento.
  • Integrações via API REST/SOAP em Apex (Named Credentials, serialização JSON/XML, tratamento de exceções).
  • Troubleshooting e análise de logs em ambientes produtivos e sandboxes.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de governor limits e estratégias de otimização.
  • Prática com Salesforce DX e Git (pull requests, code review).
  • Certificações: Platform Developer I

CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.

100% remoto.

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

You will lead, develop, and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms, particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystems, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using C# and .NET, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
  • Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
  • Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
  • Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, PostgreSQL, AWS, MongoDB,.NET, PHP, RoR, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionality

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience with expertise in C# and .NET
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications, and NetSuite
  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction
  • Strong proficiency in database design and management (Salesforce Objects and triggers, MongoDB, SQL), RESTful API development, and cloud services integration with experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in leading software product development projects
  • Hands-on experience leading technical teams both onshore, offshore & nearshore
  • Working under limited supervision and developing code for new business features based on functional and technical specs
  • Decomposes features for a sprint team into tasks that can be accomplished within a sprint; Provides work BPLOE for tasks
  • Understands and adheres to the area's software lifecycle process
  • Communicates across and outside of the team to answer questions, resolve issues, and assess impacts on other teams of changes being made in their sprint team
  • Learns and utilizes new technologies as required, serves as an expert technical resource, advisor, and mentor in one or more feature sets or technologies supported by the development team
  • Provides technical mentorship and work task direction to a team of developers; able to fill the Technical Owner role on an agile sprint team, holding people accountable for task delivery
  • Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Knowledge of authentication systems (OAuth/OICS, OWASP security best practices, including rate limiting and data encryption
  • Familiarity with AWS services, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices, with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement effective solutions
  • Experience with DMS and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Cox/VinSolutions, DealerSocket, DealerAccess), and VIN providers (e.g., DataOne, Polk, VinPower)

  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
